extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and contributors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating an existing Wikipedia page or creating a new article (including account requirements, search/redirect checks, and alternatives like drafts or requests).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural requirement for creating articles on Wikipedia; if you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create the page directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create an article directly (e.g., new user or unsure about notability), use the article wizard to produce a draft or follow the 'request a new article' process so experienced editors can review and assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Roastmaster Generals' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, search Wikipedia to avoid duplication and find possible existing coverage under different spellings or similar titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Searching for incoming links can reveal mentions, redirects, or related pages that indicate the topic is already covered or where a redirect would be appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for propagation delay or try purge if recently created
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Newly created pages might not appear immediately due to caching or replication delays; try purging the page or wait briefly before reattempting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check capitalization and consider adding a redirect
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify different capitalization variants of the title; if the correct article exists under a different capitalization, create a redirect rather than a duplicate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A missing page may have been removed; consult the deletion log and guidance on deletions to understand reasons and whether the topic can be restored or reworked to meet policy.
